roles.name: lead
roles.description: Coordinates the project, internal decisions, task ownership, integration, and final delivery. The primary session performs this role.

roles.name: requirements
roles.description: Turns the user's idea into scope, assumptions, user flows, and measurable acceptance criteria.

roles.name: researcher
roles.description: Investigates bounded technical questions and recommends practical options using evidence.

roles.name: frontend
roles.description: Builds the user interface and client behavior, coordinating an explicit contract with backend.

roles.name: backend
roles.description: Builds APIs, business logic, persistence, and integrations, coordinating an explicit contract with frontend.

roles.name: tester
roles.description: Independently tests the integrated product and records criterion-level evidence and reproducible defects.

roles.name: product_reviewer
roles.description: Independently evaluates the integrated product against user intent, acceptance criteria, and usability.
